notes: Sign in to the Control UI with the generated gateway token. OpenClaw then asks you to approve each new browser once, from the server: this runs inside the container. Over SSH run `sudo docker exec -it -u node sv-app-<id>-openclaw-1 openclaw devices list`, then `sudo docker exec -it -u node sv-app-<id>-openclaw-1 openclaw devices approve <requestId>` with the request id the browser shows; or open a shell with the Command-line access card on the app page and run `openclaw devices approve <requestId>` there. Run `devices list` right before approving, because a retrying browser gets a new request id. Once one browser is approved, further browsers can also be approved from its Devices screen.
Model providers and API keys are set from the Control UI after the browser is approved; the recipe ships no provider key.

There is no docker.sock in the container, so OpenClaw's agent sandboxing stays off and the container itself is the boundary. Agent tools run with the container's access to the /data volume and the internet.

The container starts as root only to create /data/.openclaw and /data/workspace and give them to the image's node user (Northflank layout); the gateway and its config writes run as node via setpriv. Use `-u node` with docker exec so CLI writes stay owned by node; a restart re-owns anything root left behind.

Before the gateway starts, `config set --batch-json` writes gateway.mode=local, gateway.bind=lan, the panel's HTTPS origin as the only allowed Control UI origin, and the container's own bridge gateway (/32, read from /proc/net/route at every start) as the only trusted proxy. The panel's nginx reaches the container through that address, and without it OpenClaw rejects proxied requests with proxy_attribution_required. Token auth stays on.
OPENCLAW_CONTROL_UI_ORIGIN is the url key, so a domain change or a new certificate re-renders the allowed origin. The Control UI needs HTTPS: browser device identity requires a secure context.

The exact 2026.10.2 stable release is pinned (not latest, main or extended-stable), and the plain image is used rather than the -browser variant. The 2g floor follows the RC-17 spike: about 850 MiB idle on 2026.10.1.
